title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. i wanted to ask that if i miss a rakat behind the immam.then when do i pray thanna.will it be in the rakat which i pray after immam has done salaam or in the rakat as soon as i join jamat? 1911 views Q. Can You Please tell about Performing Namaz behind Ahle Hadith and Barelwi ? Whether We can Offer Namaz behind them? As there are Only Barelwi Maskids in Our Locality. 4887 views Q. 1. Sometimes i miss something in Namaz, So not knowing that sajde sahu is wajib in this condition, I used to do sajde sahu. 7193 views Q. I live in Saudi Arabia . I follow hanafi maslak. I want to ask whether i can offer namaz back of a immam who is ghair muqallid ( wahabi) , as his akayad and way of praying the namaz is totally different from muslim. Can I eat there food or it is better to avoid it. 3088 views Q. Offering Salah while siting in Car 7531 views Q. Can a traveler be a imam and lead Isha prayer fardh 4 rakahs? 10067 views Q. While offering salah with jamah, is it necessary for the muqtadi to say "Assalamu Alaikum Wa Rahmatullah" with the imam after completing the tashahhu 2079 views Q. Namaz 3326 views Q. missing fajr prayer 3121 views Q. In lieu of below fatwa we have asked the same two months earlier with Moulana/Mufti Anees Sb of chouhan bangar,Jafrabad & he told that " Ise Momool na banaye lekin jamat e sani agar kabhi kabhi karni ho to kar sakte hai, aur uske liye main mussallah chor kar kahi bhi jamat e sani kar sakte hai aur yeh jamat bina Ehqamat ke karni hogi, Imam bina takbeer ke niyat bandh le. Now please see above lines and clarify the same. Jaza kallah previously Asked: Agar Masjid main Kharji hissa na ho aur kabhi kabhi jamat e sani karni ho to kya kar sakte hai aur uska kya tareeqa hoga? Answer: 9900 04 Jan, 2009 (Fatwa: 22/18=B/1429) According to Hanafi Fiqh, second Jamat is makrooh in the mosque of locality. If the jamat is once performed there is no need to do the second jamat. Remaining people should offer salah individually. If there is any shop, house or open place outside the main mosque where jamat is possible then it can be done there. and Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) Knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband 2286 views Q. If I am performing Qaza of a salaah at the time of the next salaah, should I perform the Qaza first or the salaah first? 7613 views Q. My question is regarding the repeating salat. Shaik, whats the masala for praying salat behind an imam who's recitation is not correct. Like, sura fatiha is not correct and other sura as well. More precisely, what if his pronunciation of the alphabets is incorrect. Besides, if someone omits the huruf al-madm in the recitation during the salat, is salat valid for the person who is following the imam. Provided that one who is follwing the imam, knows the sura correctly. Does he need to repeat his salat? Particularly Magrib, Esha & Fajr. This kind of problem arises, when I go for second Jula in other location. Sometimes, it is very hard to repeat the salat during the Magrib time. Because, our jula starts after Magrib salat. I have hard that salat will be valid if someone's recitation is correct at least three ayat in rakah. How do we have to count three ayats. Do we have to count the three ayatsafter the sura fatiha? or it includes sura fatiha with any sura? 2402 views Q. Dua After Fardh Salah 40687 views Q. How is namaz performed for or during eclipses? 2678 views Q. I want to know why people say we should not read salaam after prayers? 8422 views
answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 11379 Country: India Title: Assalamualikum Mufti Sahib? I am working in Oman, In general most of the Masjid?s and I have some issues in Namaz, can u please clarify the same, please see below the same. 1. According to Hanafi Fiqh it is Fard in Namaz (i.e) we must Stand some time (taken time of to recite Subhanalla 1 time) after takbira Taharima. If the imam is started Sura fatiya within 2 seconds after Takbira Taharima, shall we recite Sana sub..(there is no time after qiyam) ? 2. According to my Deeni friend, we must not recite Sana Sub? if the Imam is started to receite Sura Fatiya? is it correcti ? 3. In Last kaida (reciting Haitaiyatu?) there is no time to recite Dua-e-Masura(After Haitaiyatu & Darood-e-Ibrahim) as the Imam is finished Namaz by Salam?, during this sitition we need to recite Dua-e-Masura and then make Salam or we should make Salam during the time of reciting Salam (i.e.) without reciting the Dua-e-Masura Question: Assalamualikum Mufti Sahib? I am working in Oman, In general most of the Masjid?s and I have some issues in Namaz, can u please clarify the same, please see below the same. 1. According to Hanafi Fiqh it is Fard in Namaz (i.e) we must Stand some time (taken time of to recite Subhanalla 1 time) after takbira Taharima. If the imam is started Sura fatiya within 2 seconds after Takbira Taharima, shall we recite Sana sub..(there is no time after qiyam) ? 2. According to my Deeni friend, we must not recite Sana Sub? if the Imam is started to receite Sura Fatiya? is it correcti ? 3. In Last kaida (reciting Haitaiyatu?) there is no time to recite Dua-e-Masura(After Haitaiyatu & Darood-e-Ibrahim) as the Imam is finished Namaz by Salam?, during this sitition we need to recite Dua-e-Masura and then make Salam or we should make Salam during the time of reciting Salam (i.e.) without reciting the Dua-e-Masura Answer ID: 11379 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 708/708=M/1430) It is not necessary to stand up for awhile. If muqtadi performs takbeer tahreemah and then joins the imam in ruku?, he will be supposed to fulfil the obligation of standing and will be considered to have found the complete rak?ah. If you want to ask anything else, explain it and submit the question again. (2) When the imam started reciting Surah Fatihah, it is wajib to listen to it, so now there is no thana ( سبحانک اللھم بحمدک ۔۔۔۔ ). Your friend is right. (3) If some part of Du?a Mathoorah is remaining and muqtadi expects to complete it and join the first salam of imam, he should do so i.e. first should complete reciting the du?a and then join the imam in first salam, otherwise he should leave the du?a and join the imam in salam. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
